message:
Elena, Marcus, Tomas, the hidden damper can be carried without touching the deck top by clamping two transverse bearer beams to the girders with preloaded High Strength Friction Grip (HSFG, high-strength preloaded bolts) connections to carry the under-deck vertical Tuned Mass Damper (TMD, a secondary mass tuned to the bridge mode) concept (C3) as shown in the bolted frame sketch (E37). This follows the Eagles Meadow precedent (E26) and the Castle Bridge precedent (E28), with clamp bolts following the HSFG bolts guidance (E30). The load is modest because the static weight is 4.90 kN from the TMD weight calculation (E35 4.9×10³ N), about seven body weights, and the factored frame design load (E36 1.23×10⁴ N) is 12.3 kN, about one small car.

The build can be staged without full closure by prefabricating the frame plus damper off site, lifting from a tower plus under-bridge platform with one walkway kept open, locking the mass for transport and releasing after bolting, then leaving a removable cover plus shims and threaded seats for inspection and re-tuning under the staged access concept (C4). That staging uses the mobile platforms approach (E32) and keeps all appearance change below deck for the 500 kg mass from the TMD mass estimate (E22 TMD mass from 2.5 percent ratio).

Not ready, because bolt slip capacity, stroke clearance and residual acceleration still need joint checks with Elena, Marcus and Tomas.
